newsitem.title: USA: Alza to buy 4.9 pct U.S. Bioscience.
newsitem.headline: Alza to buy 4.9 pct U.S. Bioscience.

text.p: ALZA Corp and U.S. Bioscience Inc said Tuesday that U.S. Bioscience will issue 1,178,882 common shares to ALZA, which will be 4.9 percent of the outstanding shares of U.S. Bioscience, at a purchase price of $18.256 per share, for an aggregate investment of aabout $21.5 million.

A statement issued by the two companies said the purchase price is 120 percent of the average closing price of U.S. Bioscience shares as traded on the AMEX for the 10 days preceding the date of the agreement.
The statement said the transaction is expected to be completed after the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period.
The statement said U.S. Bioscience will invest a portion of the proceeds in programs supporting Ethyol, a cytoprotective agent.
Ethyol was introduced in the United States in April 1996 by ALZA Pharmaceuticals and is co-promoted by U.S. Bioscience, the statement said.
ALZA has exclusive rights to market Ethyol in the United States for five years, with an option to extend for an additional year, and is responsible for sales and marketing, the statement said.
